subject: general
question: The greatest number which divides 72 and 122 leaving remainders 3 and 7, respectively, is:
solution:
Given:

Numbers = 72, 122

Remainders = 3, 7

Concept used:

H.C.F of certain numbers

Calculation:

72 - 3 = 69

122 - 7 = 115

H.C.F of 69, 115

⇒ 69 = 23 × 3

⇒ 115 = 23 × 5

So H.C.F = 23

∴ The largest number which divides the numbers is 23
